title: Sourdough bread
description: A sourdough bread made from spelt and rye flour

steps.text: Mix the starter, the spelt flour and 175g of water. Cover it and let it sit for 12 hours (e.g. overnight).
Remove 50g from the mixture, this is your new starter. Keep it in the fridge for the next time.
Add another 400g of rye flour, 300g of water and the salt. Cover it again and let rest for 7 to 8 hours.

Add the remaining 250g of rye flour and knead the dough throroughly, while adding more flour if needed. Once kneaded, shape and dust it with flour on all sides. Put a kitchen towel in a bowl and dust it with flour. Put your bread loaf in the bowl, with the bottom facing up. Let it rest like this for another hour.
Fill a container with water and keep in the oven while pre-heating and while baking. Also keep your baking tray in the oven so it heats up. This will give the bread a nice crust.

When heated up, get a sheet of baking paper and flip the bread onto it. Cut the top of the bread in your preferred pattern. Take the hot baking tray and move the baking paper with your bread onto it. Put back in the oven.
Bake the bread for an hour until the crust is a dark brown.
